## Checklist
- [ ] Follows the Fold design system (tokens, components, motion, Reduce Motion)
- [ ] Every shown value carries Observed / Inferred / Unknown
- [ ] Changes go through preview → confirm → verify → receipt
- [ ] No secrets, UDIDs or pairing data in code, logs or screenshots
- [ ] `screenshots` CI run attached for UI changes
